sql: SELECT TOP 10 p.SKU AS sku,p.ProductName AS name,p.PimProductId AS productId,pp.price AS price,ad.addOnProductId AS addOnProductId,ad.addOnName AS addOnName,ch.child1Sku AS child1Sku,ch.child1Name AS child1Name,ch.child2Sku AS child2Sku,ch.child2Name AS child2Name,ch.child3Sku AS child3Sku,ch.child3Name AS child3Name,cat.categoryName AS categoryName,br.brandName AS brandName,pp.rp AS retailPrice,pp.sp AS salesPrice,ch.c1Id AS child1ProductId,ch.c2Id AS child2ProductId,ch.c3Id AS child3ProductId,sd.val AS shortDescription,ad.a1Pr AS addOnPrice,ad.a2Id AS addOn2ProductId,ad.a2Nm AS addOn2Name,ad.a2Pr AS addOn2Price,ad.a3Id AS addOn3ProductId,ad.a3Nm AS addOn3Name,ad.a3Pr AS addOn3Price FROM dbo.ZnodePimProduct p JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishState ps ON ps.PublishStateId=p.PublishStateId JOIN dbo.ZnodePortal po ON po.StoreCode=@store CROSS APPLY(SELECT TOP 1 COALESCE(pr.SalesPrice,pr.RetailPrice) AS price,pr.RetailPrice rp,pr.SalesPrice sp FROM dbo.ZnodePrice pr JOIN dbo.ZnodePriceList pl ON pl.PriceListId=pr.PriceListId JOIN dbo.ZnodePriceListPortal plp ON plp.PriceListId=pl.PriceListId WHERE pr.SKU=p.SKU AND plp.PortalId=po.PortalId AND pr.RetailPrice>@minPrice AND(pl.ActivationDate IS NULL OR pl.ActivationDate<=@now)AND(pl.ExpirationDate IS NULL OR pl.ExpirationDate>=@now)AND(pr.ActivationDate IS NULL OR pr.ActivationDate<=@now)AND(pr.ExpirationDate IS NULL OR pr.ExpirationDate>=@now)ORDER BY plp.Precedence,pl.PriceListId) pp OUTER APPLY(SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN ax.rn=@n1 THEN ax.id END) AS addOnProductId,MAX(CASE WHEN ax.rn=@n1 THEN ax.nm END) AS addOnName,MAX(CASE WHEN ax.rn=@n1 THEN ax.pr END) a1Pr,MAX(CASE WHEN ax.rn=@n2 THEN ax.id END) a2Id,MAX(CASE WHEN ax.rn=@n2 THEN ax.nm END) a2Nm,MAX(CASE WHEN ax.rn=@n2 THEN ax.pr END) a2Pr,MAX(CASE WHEN ax.rn=@n3 THEN ax.id END) a3Id,MAX(CASE WHEN ax.rn=@n3 THEN ax.nm END) a3Nm,MAX(CASE WHEN ax.rn=@n3 THEN ax.pr END) a3Pr FROM(SELECT ao.PimProductId AS id,ao.ProductName nm,MAX(apx.price) pr,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY ap.DisplayOrder,apd.DisplayOrder,ao.PimProductId) rn FROM dbo.ZnodePimAddOnProduct ap JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAddonGroup g ON g.PimAddonGroupId=ap.PimAddonGroupId JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAddOnProductDetail apd ON apd.PimAddOnProductId=ap.PimAddOnProductId JOIN dbo.ZnodePimProduct ao ON ao.PimProductId=apd.PimChildProductId JOIN dbo.ZnodeInventory ai ON ai.SKU=ao.SKU JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalWarehouse apw ON apw.WarehouseId=ai.WarehouseId CROSS APPLY(SELECT TOP 1 COALESCE(apr.SalesPrice,apr.RetailPrice) AS price FROM dbo.ZnodePrice apr JOIN dbo.ZnodePriceList apl ON apl.PriceListId=apr.PriceListId JOIN dbo.ZnodePriceListPortal aplp ON aplp.PriceListId=apl.PriceListId WHERE apr.SKU=ao.SKU AND aplp.PortalId=po.PortalId AND apr.RetailPrice>@minPrice AND(apl.ActivationDate IS NULL OR apl.ActivationDate<=@now)AND(apl.ExpirationDate IS NULL OR apl.ExpirationDate>=@now)AND(apr.ActivationDate IS NULL OR apr.ActivationDate<=@now)AND(apr.ExpirationDate IS NULL OR apr.ExpirationDate>=@now)ORDER BY aplp.Precedence,apl.PriceListId,apr.PriceId) apx WHERE ap.PimProductId=p.PimProductId AND ao.IsActive=@isActive AND apw.PortalId=po.PortalId AND(@addOnDisplayType IS NULL OR g.DisplayType=@addOnDisplayType)GROUP BY ao.PimProductId,ao.ProductName,ap.DisplayOrder,apd.DisplayOrder) ax) ad OUTER APPLY(SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN kc.rn=@n1 THEN kc.SKU END) AS child1Sku,MAX(CASE WHEN kc.rn=@n1 THEN kc.ProductName END) AS child1Name,MAX(CASE WHEN kc.rn=@n2 THEN kc.SKU END) AS child2Sku,MAX(CASE WHEN kc.rn=@n2 THEN kc.ProductName END) AS child2Name,MAX(CASE WHEN kc.rn=@n3 THEN kc.SKU END) AS child3Sku,MAX(CASE WHEN kc.rn=@n3 THEN kc.ProductName END) AS child3Name,MAX(CASE WHEN kc.rn=@n1 THEN kc.PimProductId END) c1Id,MAX(CASE WHEN kc.rn=@n2 THEN kc.PimProductId END) c2Id,MAX(CASE WHEN kc.rn=@n3 THEN kc.PimProductId END) c3Id FROM(SELECT c.SKU,c.ProductName,c.PimProductId,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY a.DisplayOrder,c.PimProductId) rn FROM dbo.ZnodePimProductTypeAssociation a JOIN dbo.ZnodePimProduct c ON c.PimProductId=a.PimProductId WHERE a.PimParentProductId=p.PimProductId AND c.IsActive=@isActive) kc) ch OUTER APPLY(SELECT TOP 1 ce.CategoryName AS categoryName FROM dbo.ZnodePublishProductEntity ce JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishVersionEntity cv ON cv.VersionId=ce.VersionId JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalCatalog cc ON cc.PublishCatalogId=ce.ZnodeCatalogId WHERE ce.ZnodeProductId=p.PimProductId AND cc.PortalId=po.PortalId AND cv.RevisionType=@publishState AND cv.IsPublishSuccess=@publishSuccess AND ce.IsActive=@storefrontActive AND ce.IsObsolete=@storefrontObsolete AND ce.LocaleId=@localeId ORDER BY ce.VersionId DESC,ce.ProductIndex,ce.PublishProductEntityId) cat OUTER APPLY(SELECT TOP 1 bl.BrandName AS brandName FROM dbo.ZnodeBrandDetails bd JOIN dbo.ZnodeBrandDetailLocale bl ON bl.BrandId=bd.BrandId WHERE bd.BrandCode=p.Brand AND bl.LocaleId=@localeId ORDER BY bd.BrandId,bl.BrandDetailLocaleId) br OUTER APPLY(SELECT TOP 1 sta.AttributeValue val FROM dbo.ZnodePimAttributeValue sav JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttribute spa ON spa.PimAttributeId=sav.PimAttributeId JOIN dbo.ZnodePimProductAttributeTextAreaValue sta ON sta.PimAttributeValueId=sav.PimAttributeValueId AND sta.LocaleId=@localeId WHERE sav.PimProductId=p.PimProductId AND spa.AttributeCode=@shortDescriptionCode ORDER BY sav.PimAttributeValueId) sd WHERE p.ProductType=@productType AND p.IsActive=@isActive AND ps.PublishStateCode=@publishState AND(@preferred IS NULL OR p.SKU=@preferred)AND EXISTS(SELECT c.PimProductId FROM dbo.ZnodePimProductTypeAssociation a JOIN dbo.ZnodePimProduct c ON c.PimProductId=a.PimProductId JOIN dbo.ZnodeInventory i ON i.SKU=c.SKU JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalWarehouse pw ON pw.WarehouseId=i.WarehouseId WHERE a.PimParentProductId=p.PimProductId AND c.IsActive=@isActive AND pw.PortalId=po.PortalId GROUP BY c.PimProductId HAVING SUM(i.Quantity)>=@quantityUsed)AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT a.PimProductTypeAssociationId FROM dbo.ZnodePimProductTypeAssociation a WHERE a.PimParentProductId=p.PimProductId AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT c.PimProductId FROM dbo.ZnodePimProduct c JOIN dbo.ZnodeInventory i ON i.SKU=c.SKU JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalWarehouse pw ON pw.WarehouseId=i.WarehouseId WHERE c.PimProductId=a.PimProductId AND c.IsActive=@isActive AND pw.PortalId=po.PortalId GROUP BY c.PimProductId HAVING SUM(i.Quantity)>=@quantityUsed))AND(SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ap.PimAddOnProductId)FROM dbo.ZnodePimAddOnProduct ap JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAddOnProductDetail apd ON apd.PimAddOnProductId=ap.PimAddOnProductId JOIN dbo.ZnodePimProduct ao ON ao.PimProductId=apd.PimChildProductId JOIN dbo.ZnodeInventory ai ON ai.SKU=ao.SKU JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalWarehouse apw ON apw.WarehouseId=ai.WarehouseId WHERE ap.PimProductId=p.PimProductId AND ao.IsActive=@isActive AND apw.PortalId=po.PortalId)>=@minAddOns AND(@minAddOns=@none OR ad.addOnProductId IS NOT NULL)AND(SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pa.PimAttributeId)FROM dbo.ZnodePimAttributeValue av JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttribute pa ON pa.PimAttributeId=av.PimAttributeId WHERE av.PimProductId=p.PimProductId AND pa.IsPersonalizable=@personalizable)>=@minPersonalizableAttributes AND(@personalizationAttribute IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT pa.PimAttributeId FROM dbo.ZnodePimAttributeValue av JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttribute pa ON pa.PimAttributeId=av.PimAttributeId WHERE av.PimProductId=p.PimProductId AND pa.IsPersonalizable=@personalizable AND pa.AttributeCode=@personalizationAttribute))AND EXISTS(SELECT pe.ZnodeProductId FROM dbo.ZnodePublishProductEntity pe JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishVersionEntity ve ON ve.VersionId=pe.VersionId JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalCatalog pc ON pc.PublishCatalogId=pe.ZnodeCatalogId WHERE pe.ZnodeProductId=p.PimProductId AND pc.PortalId=po.PortalId AND ve.RevisionType=@publishState AND ve.IsPublishSuccess=@publishSuccess AND pe.IsActive=@storefrontActive AND pe.IsObsolete=@storefrontObsolete AND pe.ProductIndex>=@minProductIndex)AND(SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT rq.PimAddOnProductId)FROM dbo.ZnodePimAddOnProduct rq WHERE rq.PimProductId=p.PimProductId AND rq.RequiredType=@requiredType)<=@minAddOns AND CHARINDEX(@space,p.SKU)=@none ORDER BY p.SKU
